limitations: Three predeclared bounded tests; no new signal, horizon, direction or cost search. All share exact .756 rule proposals. Floor RL and robust floor RL reuse the prior memory-trained monthly state partitions and pool. Robust objective is mean minus one sample standard deviation of leave-calendar-year-out Sharpe improvement over full-size, evaluated only on completed training outcomes. Context floor RL uses historical original put-state dates before 2018 and exact saved legacy evaluation dates thereafter, and adaptively fits up to 8 pooled leaves (min leaf max(8,min(63,n//8))). No per-pair activation, no cold-start fallback, all observed states scored. Every eligible signal remains at least half size; actual risk/quote controls still apply. Training remains additive standalone cohorts; no claim of sequential inventory-aware RL. Inspected history, not new holdout. Pre-2018 panel availability and candidate roster remain retrospective dataset conditioning.
